summary: 3D simit bakery tycoon on an old Istanbul street, built by Claude Sonnet 5.5 · Eski bir İstanbul sokağında 3D simit fırını işletme oyunu, Claude Sonnet 5.5 yaptı
key_features: Five stations from kneading to the oven; an unattended oven burns the bread
Simit sellers carry trays to the pier, school, park, office and tea houses; demand follows the hour and weather
Plan each day: production, prices, supply, staff, upgrades and contracts; poğaça, açma, çatal and pide unlock
Goal: 5,000 lira and 4 stars of reputation by day 20, then endless mode
A sensible bot wins in roughly 9 of 12 seeds (day 16-20); a careless one goes bankrupt around day 7

social.headline: Run a simit bakery in Istanbul: bake, staff the oven and send simit sellers across town · İstanbul'da simit fırını işlet: fırınla, ustaları yerleştir, simitçileri sokağa gönder
